decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - Reason for Approval: The conservatories do not have an adverse effect on neighbouring properties and are very small additions to the newc development. They preserve and enhance the character of the Conservation Area. The development complies with policies ENV-B 1.1.,ENV B.2.2 and H.6.4 of the U.D.P.
description: Erection of single storey rear conservatories to ground floor flats no 4 and 5 of approved planning permission ref 00527/41-43/P13 dated 29/09/03 for changel of use from offices to 10 residential units.  (Grove Park Conservation Area)
